info.title: PhysioDesk API
info.description: REST API for PhysioDesk, a physiotherapy clinic management system. Authenticate via **POST /api/v1/auth/login**, then use **Authorize** with the access token.

post.summary: Log in with email or username
post.description: Returns an access token (for the `Authorization: Bearer` header) and a longer-lived refresh token. The identifier may be an email address or a username.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Only refresh tokens are accepted here; access tokens are rejected.

post.summary: Log out (revokes all of the user's tokens)
post.description: Invalidates every access and refresh token previously issued to the current user, on all devices.

delete.description: Only patients with no appointments and no invoices can be deleted; otherwise 409 is returned (set status to COMPLETED or ON_HOLD instead).

get.description: Roster ordered by name, with weekly hours and patients seen today.

schema.title: Response List Therapists Api V1 Therapists Get

patch.summary: Update a therapist and their weekly schedule (admin)
patch.description: Partial update. Rejected with 409 if the new schedule (or deactivation) would leave upcoming booked appointments outside the therapist's availability.

delete.summary: Delete a therapist without appointment history (admin)
delete.description: Therapists with any appointments cannot be deleted (409); deactivate them instead. Assigned patients become unassigned.

schema.title: Response List Overrides Api V1 Therapists  Therapist Id  Schedule Overrides Get

post.summary: Create a day-off or custom-hours override (admin)
post.description: One override per therapist and date. Overrides take precedence over the weekly schedule. Rejected with 409 if it would strand upcoming booked appointments.

Validates the therapist's resolved availability for the date (overrides first, then the weekly schedule), slot alignment and conflicts. `end_time` is derived from the therapist's slot duration. Returns 409 APPOINTMENT_CONFLICT when the slot is taken (also under concurrent requests) and 400 when the slot is not bookable.

patch.description: Changing therapist, date or start time re-runs every booking rule. Status transitions: BOOKED -> COMPLETED | CANCELLED.

delete.description: Appointments are clinical history, so DELETE cancels (freeing the slot) instead of erasing the record. Idempotent; completed appointments cannot be cancelled.

get.description: For each active therapist (or the given one), every slot of the day with status OPEN, BOOKED (with patient) or THERAPIST_OFF. Slots are generated from the weekly schedule and date overrides; they are not stored.

patch.description: E.g. mark a DUE invoice as PAID. VOID invoices cannot be modified.

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Must be a slot start in the therapist's schedule. The end time is derived from the therapist's slot duration.

AppointmentUpdate.title: AppointmentUpdate
AppointmentUpdate.description:
Reschedule (therapist/date/start_time), change status or edit details.

Allowed status transitions: BOOKED -> COMPLETED | CANCELLED. COMPLETED and CANCELLED are
final; book a new appointment instead of reviving a cancelled one.

AvailabilitySource.title: AvailabilitySource
AvailabilitySource.description: Why a therapist is (un)available on a given date.

date.title: Date
date.description: Clinic-local date the statistics refer to.

patients_seen_today.title: Patients Seen Today
patients_seen_today.description: Distinct patients with a COMPLETED appointment on this date.

therapists_on_duty_today.title: Therapists On Duty Today
therapists_on_duty_today.description: Active therapists whose resolved schedule (overrides included) has them working on this date.

revenue_collected_today.title: Revenue Collected Today
revenue_collected_today.description: Sum of PAID invoice totals whose paid_at falls on this clinic date.

open_slots_remaining_today.title: Open Slots Remaining Today
open_slots_remaining_today.description: Generated slots of on-duty therapists minus non-cancelled appointments.

message.title: Message
examples: Therapist already has an appointment during this time.

paid_at.title: Paid At
paid_at.description: Defaults to now when status is PAID; must be omitted if DUE.

total.title: Total
total.description: subtotal - discount, computed by the database.

InvoiceUpdate.title: InvoiceUpdate
InvoiceUpdate.description:
Partial update, e.g. `{"status": "PAID", "payment_method": "CASH"}` to mark as paid.
Amount rules are re-checked after merging with the stored invoice.

PatientDetail.title: PatientDetail
PatientDetail.description:
Profile overview. Full session and billing history are served by the
`/patients/{id}/appointments` and `/patients/{id}/invoices` sub-resources.

last_visit_date.title: Last Visit Date
last_visit_date.description: Date of the latest COMPLETED session.

is_day_off.title: Is Day Off
is_day_off.description: True: therapist is off. False: works custom hours.

booked_slots.title: Booked Slots
booked_slots.description: Slots holding a BOOKED or COMPLETED appointment.

working_days.title: Working Days
working_days.description: ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. Duplicates are removed.

patients_seen_today.title: Patients Seen Today
patients_seen_today.description: Distinct patients with a COMPLETED appointment with this therapist today.

anyOf.description: ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. Duplicates are removed.
